checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from manifest

checks.name: NumberOfResults limits
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from manifest
checks.notes: These are request configuration values, not completeness thresholds.

checks.name: Five-minute heartbeat due-target distribution
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from pure schedule reconciliation
checks.notes: The sequence is a design invariant, not a production coverage claim.

checks.name: Persisted phase capacities
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from manifest
checks.notes: Phase indexes/capacities remain the persisted Stage 13 assignments.

checks.name: Logical requests per 30 minutes
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from pure schedule reconciliation
checks.notes: Logical requests are distinct from transport attempts and provider usage.

checks.name: Logical requests per hour
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from pure schedule reconciliation
checks.notes: Logical requests are distinct from live client invocations.

checks.name: Maximum concurrency
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from approved runtime constants; observed runs are reported separately
checks.notes: No production scheduler is deployed by this contract.

checks.name: Maximum attempts
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from approved runtime constants
checks.notes: This permits at most one automatic retry.

checks.name: Maximum automatic retries per logical target execution
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from approved runtime constants
checks.notes: Retry-rate acceptance remains policy pending.

checks.name: No catch-up or replay of missed realtime buckets
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from schedule-engine behavior
checks.notes: A missed bucket is a coverage state, not a reason to replay transport.

checks.name: Duplicate dispatcher invocations do not create duplicate target transport
checks.evidence_required: dispatcher claims, duplicate events, target audits, HTTP attempts
checks.status_behavior: PASS only with duplicate evidence; NOT_APPLICABLE without a duplicate invocation sample; FAIL on duplicate transport
checks.notes: Absence of a duplicate sample is not a production PASS.

checks.name: One target failure does not abort unrelated due targets
checks.evidence_required: target audits for a run containing a failure and unrelated due targets
checks.status_behavior: PASS only with failure-isolation evidence; NOT_APPLICABLE without a failure sample; FAIL when unrelated due work is aborted
checks.notes: A failure percentage threshold is not defined here.

checks.name: Automatic retry protection boundary
checks.evidence_required: quota decisions and shared usage where available
checks.status_behavior: PASS at or below the boundary and for correctly denied projected retries; FAIL when an automatic retry crosses it
checks.notes: This is not a minimum-utilization target.

checks.name: Normal operational maximum
checks.evidence_required: shared usage and initial quota decisions where available
checks.status_behavior: PASS at or below the boundary and for correctly denied projected initial usage; FAIL when normal operation crosses it
checks.notes: No planned operation above this value is approved.

checks.name: Provider absolute ceiling
checks.evidence_required: shared usage and provider-attempt evidence where available
checks.status_behavior: PASS at or below the ceiling; FAIL when observed or projected provider usage crosses it
checks.notes: The provider-wide maximum remains a guarded absolute ceiling, not a utilization target.

checks.name: Simulation/offline attempts do not count as provider usage
checks.evidence_required: attempt transport metadata and quota/shared-usage evidence
checks.status_behavior: PASS when offline attempts carry no provider-attempt accounting; FAIL if they do
checks.notes: Local simulation activity remains separate from provider consumption.

checks.name: Legacy7 identity preservation
checks.approved_expected_value: exactly seven approved source identities mapped to lineage IDs 1 through 7
checks.status_behavior: PASS or FAIL from manifest
checks.notes: Legacy7 identities remain distinct and preserved.

checks.name: Real Tiered50 sampling-era transition
checks.evidence_required: real production cutover evidence and pre/post records
checks.status_behavior: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or NOT_APPLICABLE before real cutover; never PASS from manifest configuration
checks.notes: Stage 15B has not started and no cutover timestamp may be invented.

checks.name: Legacy7 history and identity remain continuous across cutover
checks.status_behavior: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE before real cutover; PASS/FAIL only after real evidence exists
checks.notes: Delete/reinsert continuity breaks must remain visible.

checks.name: Post-cutover records are attributed to Tiered50
checks.evidence_required: real cutover timestamp and post-cutover records
checks.status_behavior: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE before real cutover; PASS/FAIL only after real evidence exists
checks.notes: Sampling-era labels in the pre-cutover development manifest are not production cutover evidence.
